children: Canada industrial valve maker's Q2 sales declined 15% yr/yr due to shipment delays and softer bookings
Adjusted net loss for Q2 widened, reflecting lower sales and significant transaction-related costs
Company implemented workforce reduction subsequent to Q2 and suspended dividend for remainder of fiscal 2027
Velan expects near-term order activity to remain mixed across regions
Company says demand in core nuclear, defense and energy markets remains solid
Velan expects workforce reduction to improve cost structure over coming fiscal quarters
SHIPMENT DELAYS - Co said lower sales in Q2 were mainly due to delays in certain large-project deliveries and production challenges
SOFTER BOOKINGS - Co attributed weaker order intake in nuclear, power and process end-markets in North America and continued soft bookings in China to lower Q2 bookings
TRANSACTION COSTS - Co said Q2 net loss was mainly driven by $14.9 mln of transaction-related costs
